about.description: Saya Samsul Maarif, mahasiswa S1 Teknik Informatika di Universitas Pamulang dan Lulusan SMK Letris Indonesia 2 Jurusan Rekayasa Perangkat Lunak. Memiliki minat besar di bidang Web Developer dan Mobile Developer, serta memiliki pengalaman dan pengetahuan yang kuat terkait pembuatan aplikasi berbasis web dan mobile.
about.secondaryDescription: Berpengalaman mengerjakan berbagai proyek, dari website hingga aplikasi mobile, dengan fokus pada UI/UX yang modern dan performa yang optimal. Terbiasa menggunakan Flutter, Laravel, dan berbagai teknologi modern lainnya.
about.description_en: I'm Samsul Maarif, an Informatics Engineering undergraduate at Universitas Pamulang and a graduate of SMK Letris Indonesia 2 majoring in Software Engineering. I have a strong interest in web and mobile development, with solid experience and knowledge in building web- and mobile-based applications.
about.secondaryDescription_en: Experienced in working on various projects, from websites to mobile apps, with a focus on modern UI/UX and optimal performance. Comfortable using Flutter, Laravel, and various other modern technologies.

projects.title: Shamo Flutter App
projects.description: Aplikasi e-commerce sepatu cross-platform berbasis Flutter. Fitur lengkap: product listing dengan kategori, cart management, autentikasi user, dan integrasi REST API backend. Dibangun dari kursus BWA dengan arsitektur clean code.
projects.description_en: A cross-platform shoe e-commerce app built with Flutter. Full features: categorized product listing, cart management, user authentication, and REST API backend integration. Built from the BWA course with a clean-code architecture.

projects.title: Web Pengumpulan Tugas Mahasiswa
projects.description: Sistem manajemen pengumpulan tugas kuliah berbasis browser. Upload file, tracking deadline per mata kuliah, notifikasi, dan manajemen data mahasiswa. Deployed di Vercel — fully functional tanpa backend.
projects.description_en: A browser-based college assignment submission system. File uploads, deadline tracking per course, notifications, and student data management. Deployed on Vercel — fully functional without a backend.

projects.title: Coworkers
projects.description: Aplikasi manajemen coworking space berbasis web. Booking ruang kerja, manajemen member, jadwal ruangan, dan dashboard admin terintegrasi.
projects.description_en: A coworking-space management app. Workspace booking, member management, room schedules, and an integrated admin dashboard.

projects.title: Web Tiket Online
projects.description: Platform pemesanan tiket online berbasis web. Sistem manajemen tiket lengkap dengan autentikasi pengguna, pemilihan kursi, dan konfirmasi pemesanan.
projects.description_en: A web-based online ticket booking platform. Complete ticket management with user authentication, seat selection, and order confirmation.
